definition: [ מְרֵרָה ] noun feminine gall ; only suffix יִשְׁפֹּךְ לָאָרֶץ מְרֵרָתִי Job 16:13 he poureth on the ground my gall (|| יְפַלַּח כִּלְיוֺתַי ), figurative of God's cruel treatment (compare מְרֹרָה Job 20:25 ).
